answer: Relic-draw identity lottery. Each period a public verifiable-randomness beacon outputs a seed after registration closes, then assigns each applicant a relic—a single-use slot drawn from a fixed onyx pool of N slots. Lotus rule: an identity is valid only if its drawn slot falls below a live threshold, so an attacker who floods M registrations cannot know in advance which survive; expected cost per surviving identity scales with M/N, forcing overpayment for every accepted one.
